exhibitions.title: Permanent Installation of Public Art
exhibitions.description: ' This is the nation's first all-electric, carbon-neutral hospital. Its art committee has chosen works in all media, including work celebrating the flora and fauna of our region, its marshes, chaparral, beaches, and parkland.....highlighting the diversity of Southern California, our cultural heritage, and activities promoting health and wellness. Art there will hopefully provide inspiration and comfort to patients and visitors! The medical complex overlooks the San Joaquin Marsh Reserve and features nature trails to enhance the health and well-being of patients and visitors alike.'

exhibitions.title: 36 Paper Pictures: Washi, Scraps, and Souvenirs
exhibitions.description: Lucie Galvin was featured by the Newport Beach Arts Commission in a solo exhibition at the Central Library gallery. The show highlighted her Paper Pictures to date -  intricate tactile collages recently informed by studying papermaking in Japan and South Korea. The exhibition showcased Lucie's unique sustainable palette of papers of organic plant fibers (such as mulberry, banana, and hemp) as well as ubiquitous cardstock, upcycled greeting cards, gift wrap, grocery bags, pizza boxes, and more. Featuring pieces deeply tied to local culture like 'Goldenrod Footbridge' the exhibition explored the interplay of texture and memory, transforming everyday scraps into sophisticated low-relief structural narratives.
